tests: A realistic difficult business report combining most other corpus cases in one file across five pages.
adversarialFeatures: cover page whose largest text is the title but which has no metadata title backing it
table of contents as a plain ordered list with no links and no page numbers
CSS multi-column text on one page only
one fully ruled table and one borderless table with merged headers and blank cells
an inline SVG chart duplicating the ruled table's data
two captioned photographs and one uncaptioned decorative rule
a logo repeating in the brand bar on four of five pages
title: Coastal Depot: Annual Review 2026
readingOrder: page 2 brand bar (artifact), Contents heading, TOC list, footer (artifact)
page 3 brand bar, Summary heading, three column-flowed paragraphs, Throughput heading, ruled table with caption, chart, chart description, footer
page 4 brand bar, Fleet utilisation heading, note paragraph, borderless table, decorative rule, Site heading, Figure 1 + caption, Northern apron heading, Figure 2 + caption, footer
page 5 brand bar, Options heading, three-item list, closing paragraph with two links, footer
readingOrderNote: The page-3 Summary uses CSS columns, so its three paragraphs flow down the left column then the right. Only that section is multi-column.

pagesNote: Measured, not estimated: cover plus five content pages. The page-3 entries in headingHierarchy refer to content page numbering as printed in the footers, which lags the physical page index by one.

groundTruthCorrections.reason: Both tables declared mergedCells and rowHeaders but no headerStructure, so their column headers were never named. The throughput table is the same table as 03-simple-table's, where headerStructure IS declared — an inconsistency in the original fixture, not a change of intent.
groundTruthCorrections.found: A strengthened comparator check (TH contents vs ground truth, not just TH count) reported 6 cells 'promoted to /TH that ground truth does not name'. Those 6 were the legitimate column headers. The remediation was correct; the fixture was incomplete.
groundTruthCorrections.effect: Adds the header names already implied by mergedCells and by the document's own HTML. No expectation was weakened or altered to accommodate a result.
